locale.description: This locale's folder in _locales; the extension uses it to tell which locale the browser picked.

description.message: Translate text and pages with PLaMo 3 Translate on this computer: through PLaMo Translate Desktop, or right in the browser.

sourcePlaceholder.message: Text to translate. Select text on a page and choose "Translate with PLaMo" from the context menu, or type or paste it here (Ctrl+Enter translates).

doneCut.message: Done · $COUNT$ passage(s) kept repeating and were cut

noticeSetup.message: Cannot reach PLaMo Translate Desktop. Open the app, go to Settings (the gear in the status bar), and choose "Connect" under Browser extension. Then reload this panel.

noticeDisconnected.message: The connection to PLaMo Translate Desktop ended: $ERROR$

errorNoModel.message: No model is selected. Choose and download one in PLaMo Translate Desktop (the model button in the status bar).

errorModelMissing.message: The selected model file is missing. Choose a model again in PLaMo Translate Desktop.

settingsHint.message: Downloaded models are listed; download others in PLaMo Translate Desktop. Changing these does not change the app's own selection.

releaseTitle.message: End the connection to PLaMo Translate Desktop and free the model's memory. The next translation loads it again.

shortcutsChangeTitle.message: Opens the browser's page for the shortcuts of extensions, where the keys are set. The browser does not let an extension set them.

translatePageTitle.message: Translate the page in the current tab. Right-clicking the page and choosing "Translate this page with PLaMo" also works.

pageNotAllowed.message: The browser lets the panel translate only a tab where the right-click menu or one of the extension's shortcuts was used (not the toolbar button), until it goes to another site. Right-click this page and choose "Translate this page with PLaMo", or allow the extension on all sites.

pageCannotTranslate.message: This page cannot be translated: the browser does not let extensions run on it (browser pages, extension stores, error pages, and the like).

pageClose.message: Close and stop translating this page

statusReleasedDetail.message: The model loads again on the next translation.

pageStoppedForOther.message: Stopped: another page is being translated

settingsHintBrowser.message: In the browser, translation runs on this computer with WebAssembly or WebGPU, without the app. Models up to 2B fit; the larger ones need the app.

licenseNotice.message: The models are under the PLaMo Community License: personal and non-commercial use is free, and commercial use needs registration. Downloading one means accepting the license.

licenseUrl.description: The license in the display language.

statusMeasuring.message: Measuring the CPU and the GPU (first use only)…

statusNoModelBrowser.message: No model downloaded yet: download one under Settings

errorNoModelBrowser.message: No model is downloaded in the browser yet. Download one under Settings.

releaseTitleBrowser.message: Free the model's memory, including GPU memory. The next translation loads it again.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete $WHAT$ from the browser? Using it again means downloading it again.

stopPageTitle.message: Stop the translation of the page in the current tab; the box on the page can resume it.

statusGpuUnavailable.message: the GPU could not be used

resetSettingsConfirm.message: Reset the extension's settings, including the license acceptance and the measured device? Downloaded models are kept.

engineAutoApp.description: The engine Automatic uses now: the app's

engineAutoBrowser.description: The engine Automatic uses now: the in-browser one

deviceAutoIs.description: The device Automatic uses, such as GPU or Vulkan0

deviceAutoApp.description: Inside 'Same as the app (…)': the device the app's Automatic uses

measure.description: Button: measure the GPU and the CPU again (as in the app)

measureTitle.message: Translates a short text with the current model on the GPU and the CPU, and makes Automatic use the faster. Takes from a few seconds to a minute; page translation waits meanwhile.

measuredSpeed.description: One device's generation speed in the measurement

measuredFailed.description: A device that failed in the measurement

statusMeasuringAgain.message: Measuring the GPU and the CPU…
statusMeasuringAgain.description: Status while measuring again from the button

appGuide.message: How to set up the app
appGuide.description: Link after the in-browser engine's hint, to the README's steps for the app and the extension

appGuideUrl.description: The README section on the browser extension, in this language

pageMarks.description: Setting: a pulsing frame on the page over the paragraphs the engine is translating

pageNearby.description: Setting: page translation sends only the paragraphs within a screen of the view, and the others when scrolled to

parallelPages.description: Setting (in-browser engine): page batches side by side

parallelPagesHint.message: Faster, but each paragraph is translated with less of the text before it, so the wording may be a little off.

pageNearbyHint.message: The rest is translated as you scroll to it.

extensionUpdated.message: The extension's files are now version $VERSION$. Reload it to use them.

extensionNewVersion.message: Version $VERSION$ of the extension is out.

checkUpdatesHint.message: Asks GitHub at most once a day whether a newer version of the extension is out.
